source_row.rationale: Pulmonary artery wedge pressure (PAWP), obtained via a pulmonary artery (Swan-Ganz) catheter, is used to estimate left atrial pressure and left ventricular filling pressure (preload), providing valuable information about left heart function and fluid status in critically ill clients, particularly useful in differentiating cardiogenic from non-cardiogenic causes of pulmonary edema.
source_row.source_detail: Hemodynamic interpretation: PAWP/PCWP estimates left atrial and left-sided filling pressure when measured correctly; StatPearls; accessed 2026-08-14.
